callCheck.title: Call check
callCheck.intro: For the technical check: two windows or two devices call each other, to see whether they connect and which way the audio goes. One side clicks "Start", sends "My connection details" to the other, who pastes them into "Their connection details", clicks "Use" and sends theirs back; the first side pastes those and clicks "Use".
callCheck.loading: Getting an account for the relay…
callCheck.noRelay: No relay configured: direct connections only
callCheck.mine: My connection details (send to the other side)
callCheck.badSignal: These connection details can't be read. Please copy them again.
callCheck.startFirst: This is an answer. Click "Start" first.
callCheck.nextOffer: Next: send the details above to the other side. Paste what they send back below and press "Use".
callCheck.nextAnswer: Next: send the details above back to the other side. Once they paste them and press "Use", the call connects.

groupCheck.title: Group call check
groupCheck.intro: For technical verification: several windows or devices join the same room to see whether they hear each other, which path the audio takes and how much traffic it uses. Click "Join" on each device; one account can open several windows, and each counts as one person. The audio is forwarded by the server. Keep the devices apart or wear headphones, otherwise you will hear an echo.
groupCheck.startAudio: Click here to start playing audio
groupCheck.notSetUp: This server has no media server set up for group calls
groupCheck.withCameraHint: Unticked, you get a ticket like a voice call's: use it to confirm that sending pictures with it is refused.
